name: example-motionsites-mainframe-hero
title: Mainframe Motion Hero
description: A cinematic creative-agency hero with fullscreen character video, mouse-driven video scrubbing, editorial typography, typewriter copy, compact action pills, and a responsive mobile menu.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 电影感创意机构 Hero，包含全屏人物视频、鼠标横向擦洗、编辑排印、打字机文案、紧凑操作胶囊和响应式移动菜单。
description_i18n.en: A cinematic creative-agency hero with fullscreen character video, mouse-driven video scrubbing, editorial typography, typewriter copy, compact action pills, and a responsive mobile menu.

query.en: Create a cinematic fullscreen creative-agency hero using the Mainframe motion template, then replace the brand and copy while preserving its video choreography and responsive behavior.
query.zh-CN: 使用 Mainframe 动效模板创建电影感全屏创意机构 Hero，替换品牌和文案，同时保留视频编排与响应式行为。
